FXAA 3.11 by Timothy Lottes, NVIDIA Corporation.

The edge anti-aliasing shader of this renderer (edge_aa_fs in
gpu/shadps4/video_core/renderer_metal/mtl_blit_shaders.h) is a port to the Metal Shading Language of
the quality path of FXAA3_11.h from the NVIDIA GameWorks Graphics Samples
(https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/GraphicsSamples, samples/es3-kepler/FXAA/FXAA3_11.h), changed to
compute luma per tap. The original is distributed under the following licence:
